purpose: Live city parcel qualification with unmodified responses through the repository adapter; IDs and hashes retained, full geometries confined to temporary audit cache except three public samples.

descriptor.name: Geobasis NRW ALKIS parcels
descriptor.scope: Seven valid distinct NRW ALKIS cadastral references verified in thirteen bounded 0.001-degree cells around the unchanged Wuppertal WUP settlement locator. Complete offset paging, forced three-row geometry pages, all seven fresh exact native cadastral identities, explicit absence, footprint and source binding passed in twenty requests. Independent metric EPSG:32632 GEOS found all geometries valid and distinct, with no sampled overlaps above 0.01 m² or operation errors. Existing official North Rhine-Westphalia OGC API and native flstkennz namespace are reused. The original exact-point WFS sample and API polygon share the same native key; independent projected comparison finds Hausdorff distance 0.000006263 metres and symmetric difference 0.0099301 m², consistent with the two published CRS transformations, rather than byte-identical coordinates. Both complete source shapes remain unchanged. Wider municipal completeness, legal title, survey accuracy, currentness and long-term identity continuity remain unverified.
descriptor.attribution: Bezirksregierung Köln / Geobasis NRW, ALKIS simplified schema. Datenlizenz Deutschland – Zero 2.0. Adapted to WGS84.
